findings.impact: The checkpoint records PREFLIGHT_CLEAN while leaving complexitySha256 null and claiming its identity exists in a release receipt, but commit 1164723 contains no such receipt. The test/typecheck/build results are likewise only transcribed into prose/JSON. Consequently the deterministic verification state is not commit-bound evidence and cannot be independently checked from this checkpoint.
findings.minimal_fix: Commit a machine-readable release/verification receipt bound to commit 1164723 that contains the preflight complexity digest and command-result identities, then reference its path and hash from both report formats; otherwise downgrade these fields to unverified recorded claims and remove the nonexistent receipt assertion.
